name: RUPTURE Master Art Direction
subtitle: Consistency Without Repetition · Variation Without Chaos
philosophy: The result should feel like a physical, tangible sculptural object made from impossible liquid metal or vitreous film, photographed in a dark, controlled studio void. Consistency lives in the artistic DNA (materials, lighting, rendering quality, obsidian negative space); variation thrives in sculptural forms, compositions, perspectives, and visual rhythms.

materials.name: Liquid Mirror Chrome
materials.description: Photorealistic polished chrome and liquid mercury with fluid surface tension necks and specular highlights.

materials.name: Razor-Sheared Strata
materials.description: Horizontal laminar metallic planes, stepped brutalist terraces, and planar bevels with sharp shadow valleys.

materials.name: Pearlescent Silver Fluid
materials.description: Velvety nacreous luster, soft white specular glow, and continuous undulating laminar waves.

materials.name: Translucent Glass Membrane
materials.description: Gossamer-thin vitreous films and optical silica sheets with cyan and lavender caustic dispersion.

materials.name: Reflective Globes & Rings
materials.description: Distorted toroidal apertures, elliptical liquid chrome annuli, and circular capillary momentum.

refractedAccents.name: Pale Cyan (#7AE7FF)
refractedAccents.rule: Refracted iridescent highlight in glass membranes and liquid chrome

refractedAccents.name: Icy Blue (#5EC5FF)
refractedAccents.rule: Cold directional specular rim light on metallic contours

refractedAccents.name: Lavender (#C8B6FF)
refractedAccents.rule: Subtle nacreous iridescence along folded liquid surfaces

refractedAccents.name: Deep Ultraviolet (#7A2CFF)
refractedAccents.rule: Refracted inside concave metallic shadows and membrane crevices

isolatedAccent.name: Molten Crimson (#FF3344)
isolatedAccent.rule: Strictly restricted to Post 05 (Main Event Poster) and Post 13 (Last Tickets / Capacity Warning). Never used across standard campaign posts.

prohibitions: No saturated primary colors (pure green, yellow, orange)

lighting.keylight: Controlled low-key studio keylight creating dramatic specular falloff from pure white to deep charcoal
lighting.rim: Chiseled directional rim lighting grazing metallic boundaries
lighting.refraction: Physically accurate caustics passing through translucent membranes without lighting up the background
lighting.shadows: Deep cavernous shadows dissolving into 100% black negative space

rendering.standard: Photorealistic 3D rendering with microscopic surface tension beads, tangible material weight, physically convincing refraction, and zero CGI plastic look.

atmosphere.mood: Mysterious, cold, hypnotic, futuristic, underground techno, architectural minimalism.

backgrounds.environment: Infinite dark studio void with 60% to 75% controlled negative space for typography and breathing room.

exclusions: People, faces, human bodies, humanoids or robots
Generic cyberpunk cityscapes, flying cars, or neon streets
Literal DJ equipment, headphones, mixers, speakers, or crowd shots
Random glitch effects, scanlines, or distorted pixel noise
Typography or watermarks embedded into master artwork itself

low.name: LOW // Tight Curatorial Control
low.description: Stay strictly loyal to established master references. Minimal deviation in silhouette, camera angle, and composition.

medium.name: MEDIUM // Balanced Creative Exploration (Default)
medium.description: Maintain identical material and lighting physics while exploring noticeably diverse shapes, asymmetrical layouts, scale shifts, and macro crops.

high.name: HIGH // Adventurous Permutations
high.description: Experimental topological knots, bold off-axis camera angles, dramatic negative space splits, and complex multi-object tensions while respecting Master DNA.

sculptural-chrome__folded-surfaces.recommendation: Dominant: Sculptural Chrome (60-70%) · Secondary: Folded Surfaces (30-40%)
similarities: Shared liquid platinum and pure chrome tonal range
conflicts: None; high-tension fluid necks contrast cleanly with planar horizontal strata

pearlescent-silver__translucent-glass.recommendation: Dominant: Pearlescent Silver (60%) · Secondary: Translucent Glass (40%)
similarities: Shared cyan and lavender caustic dispersion
conflicts: Ensure vitreous glass maintains enough opacity so it does not disappear against nacreous swells

reflective-globes__sculptural-chrome.recommendation: Dominant: Reflective Globes (55%) · Secondary: Sculptural Chrome (45%)
conflicts: Avoid mixing too many rings with chaotic splash droplets

folded-surfaces__pearlescent-silver.recommendation: Dominant: Folded Surfaces (60%) · Secondary: Pearlescent Silver (40%)
conflicts: Harsh razor edges should be softened with nacreous diffuse luster

reflective-globes__translucent-glass.recommendation: Dominant: Reflective Globes (50%) · Secondary: Translucent Glass (50%)
conflicts: Avoid cluttered nested rings that distract from clean glass membrane clarity

translucent-glass__folded-surfaces.recommendation: Dominant: Translucent Glass (65%) · Secondary: Folded Surfaces (35%)
conflicts: Extreme mass disparity: gossamer diaphanous film vs brutalist heavy stone-like terraces

sculptural-chrome__pearlescent-silver.recommendation: Dominant: Sculptural Chrome (70%) · Secondary: Pearlescent Silver (30%)
conflicts: Specular contrast clash: harsh mirror chrome glare fights velvety diffuse nacreous silk
